column1: # Stage S3 — foundation cycles: the wire and value types the session and the transport share move
# down into the transport, the session gates move up into the session, and the moved items'
# consumers follow. Paths name the tree after s3_frontend_layers.tsv.
# the account tier ladder is the wire enum the API sends: a transport DTO module
# the per-tab single-flight cell type serves the client's refresh-and-retry contract
# the session gates read the session store: they belong to the session, not to the primitives
# crate paths of the moved modules and of the re-exports that named them
# the signed-in account and the rotated token pair leave the session file for the auth DTOs
# the session refresh (cross-tab lock, peer rotation, cold-start restore) moves up into the session
